name: StormOutageRestorationConsole
tagline: Storm desk in one control: customers out, crews, ETRs and a public outage view.
description: Complete outage restoration app for electric utilities and co-ops: incident register with priorities and wire-down hazards, drag-and-drop crew board, ETR estimates from each crew's backlog (storm mode), partial and full restoration with rules, schematic outage map, ETR timeline, KPIs and a public outage page for Power Pages.
features: Customers out, critical customers and wire-down hazards
Drag-and-drop crew dispatch with crew load and shift end
Storm-mode ETR estimation from crew backlog
Bulk dispatch / ETR / restore / cancel with undo
CSV and SummaryJson for Teams, Power BI and SMS flows
